method.notes: Vegetarian Vietnamese-style enclosed steamed bun with cooked common mushroom, soy sauce and hard-boiled egg. Four small buns; the dish is distinct from the existing open folded bao with cucumber and hoisin. All edible ingredients weighed. Full oil retention. No physical cooking test.

food_safety.notes: Cook the egg until fully set. Cook mushrooms before filling the buns and steam until the dough is done and the filling is steaming hot. Disclose egg, soy and wheat.

servings_and_time.notes: 2 portions with 150 minutes including the specified cooking and resting or cooling periods.
